proof_body:
by
  intro F f S x e he hx hb h
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 h e he)
  have h1 := hK K le_rfl (x K) (hx K)
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at h1
  linarith [hb K]
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (e : ℝ), 0 < e → (∀ n, x n ∈ S) → (∀ n, e ≤ |F n (x n) - f (x n)|) → ¬ TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop S
